name: New SVG Icons
author: Pranav MT

sections.description:
New SVG Icons allows administrators to insert SVG code and reference it using a shortcode in posts, pages, or widgets. It’s built with strict security and follows WordPress plugin development best practices.

Use [svg_icon name="your_icon_name"] in your content to show the icon.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/new-svg-icons directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Navigate to ‘SVG Icons’ in the admin menu to add SVGs.
sections.faq:
How do I add a new icon?

Go to “SVG Icons” in the admin dashboard, enter a unique name, paste your SVG code, and save.

How do I display an icon?

Use the shortcode [svg_icon name="your_icon_name"].
